description: Restricted to what the frontend actually calls: core:event's allow-listen, for the `listen()` calls that receive the `snapshot`/`usage`/`connection-status` events (src/main.ts). No core:window permission is granted: `window.show()` is called from Rust, inside the report_ready command (commands.rs), not through IPC from the webview, so it needs no ACL entry. No fs, shell, dialog, or http plugin permissions are granted either -- this app depends on none of those plugins. The app's own #[tauri::command] functions in commands.rs (including the raw-bytes Channel used for surface frames) are callable from the webview without a separate ACL entry.
